title: •Corporal Vandolay
caption: •Corporal Vandolay (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. Opponent’s smugglers are forfeit -2. During any control phase, may ▲ one Spice Mines Of Kessel. Once per game, may ▲ an Immediate Effect and/or a prison.
lore: ISB attaché to the _Executor_. Detention Officer. Political Liaison for COMPNOR. Responsible for all prisoner transfers. Fiercely loyal to the Emperor’s New Order.

notes: Unique. {pilot:2} at the start (stub omits it). Slip prints ▲ twice where the stub expands 'take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. Third stat box printed blank. Icon column: pilot, warrior (printed card has Warrior only). Imperial. Lore corrected from scan: 'attaché' with the acute accent (wiki 'attache'), 'Executor' italic, curly apostrophe in Emperor’s — all confirmed on the 745 px V1 remake. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1997 (Dagobah) not legible. Modern: V1-D-corporalvandolay.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 1 — different game text); VB2 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
